lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in approximately five vertical columns. The largest centroids are located in the mid-flank region, while the dorsal-most clusters show higher spatial density and smaller diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lighter pixels intersect with the primary horizontal ridges, creating a grid-like structure where each high-luminance blob is centered within a rectangular cell.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Four distinct horizontal ridges traverse the flank, characterized by sharp vertical gradients with peak luminance on the dorsal edge of each ridge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.
